## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Phase 0 Governance Check

- [ ] Which layer is affected?
- [ ] What is pre/current/post?
- [ ] What are phi_in and phi_out?
- [ ] What does beta do?
- [ ] What invariants are preserved?
- [ ] What forbidden transitions are blocked?
- [ ] What residuals can be emitted?
- [ ] Can this code issue Certificate?
- [ ] If yes, where are ProofObject, GovernanceGate, and ReverseTrace?
- [ ] What tests prove compliance?

## Safety Gates

- [ ] No runtime behavior changes (if Phase 0 doc/governance PR)
- [ ] Docs and instructions only (if Phase 0 doc/governance PR)
- [ ] Existing tests unaffected
- [ ] All required CI checks are green with no pending checks
